name: CWEval
intro: CWEval 是同时评测 LLM 生成代码功能性与安全性的结果驱动框架；其公开 CWEval-bench 含 119 个安全关键编码任务，覆盖 31 类 CWE 和 5 种编程语言。
build_method: 依据 CWE 文档设计自包含安全关键任务，为每题编写无安全提示泄漏的清晰规格、功能与安全动态判定器，以及安全和功能正确但不安全的双参考实现并由专家验证
metric: func@k（通过全部功能测试）与 func-sec@k（同时通过全部功能和安全测试），采用无偏 pass@k 式估计
eval_feature: 功能与安全联合动态执行；结果驱动判定
scale: 119 个任务 · 31 类 CWE · 5 种语言
build_method_en: Derive self-contained security-critical tasks from CWE documentation; write clear specifications without security-awareness leakage, dynamic functionality/security oracles, and secure plus functional-but-insecure reference implementations; then expert-verify each task
eval_feature_en: Joint dynamic functionality and security execution with outcome-driven oracles
intro_en: CWEval is an outcome-driven framework that evaluates the functionality and security of LLM-generated code simultaneously; its public CWEval-bench contains 119 security-critical tasks spanning 31 CWEs and five programming languages.
metric_en: func@k for passing all functionality tests and func-sec@k for passing all functionality and security tests, using unbiased pass@k-style estimators
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the independent CWEval paper arXiv:2501.08200 Sections III–V and the official Co1lin/CWEval repository, rather than treating CWEval as a Qwen-only vulnerability-repair benchmark. Tasks are derived from CWE documentation and isolate third-party dependencies while preserving security-critical behavior. Every specification includes a function signature, natural-language docstring and optional examples, must contain security semantics, intentionally avoids security-awareness hints, and remains functionally unambiguous. Each task has dynamic functionality oracles based on expected behavior and security oracles that may inspect outputs, execution time, memory validity or state integrity. A secure reference implementation must pass both suites; at least one functional-but-insecure implementation must pass functionality and fail security, proving vulnerability reproducibility and feasible mitigation without sacrificing function. Expert programmers manually verify the tasks. CWEval-bench contains 119 tasks covering 31 CWEs across five languages, including 11 C-specific memory-vulnerability tasks. Model samples are executed against both oracle suites. func@k estimates the probability that any of k samples is functional, while func-sec@k requires both functionality and security; both use the unbiased pass@k estimator.
